name: Media Lyrics Card
author: Guranex
description: The end-4 (illogical-impulse) lyrics media player card, ported to the Omarchy shell as a desktop widget: cover art, transport, an expandable synced-lyrics panel, and five sizes, in an Omarchy or a Material 3 style. Ported from end-4/dots-hyprland (GPL-3.0).

barWidget.description: A now-playing card with synced lyrics on the desktop, in an Omarchy or Material 3 style.

schema.label: Show the card on the desktop
schema.description: Draws the card above the wallpaper and below your windows.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: omarchy follows the active Omarchy theme; material is end-4's Material 3 baseline.

schema.label: Icon font
schema.description: auto uses Material Symbols when installed and Nerd Font otherwise.

schema.label: Card size
schema.description: Any of 1x1, 1x2, 2x2, 1x3, 2x3. Drag the corner handle on the card to change it.

schema.label: Screen position
schema.description: Any corner, or free once the card has been dragged by its top-right grip.

schema.label: Free position, X
schema.description: The card's left edge in screen pixels, set by dragging.

schema.label: Free position, Y
schema.description: The card's top edge in screen pixels, set by dragging.

schema.label: Limit the card to one monitor
schema.description: A connector name such as eDP-1. Leave empty for every monitor.

schema.label: Preferred media player
schema.description: Matched against the player's name, for example 'spotify'. Leave empty to follow whatever is playing.

schema.label: Lock the card size
schema.description: Hides the resize handle so the size cannot be changed by dragging.
